assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurologic deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
raising concern for a paroxysmal arrhythmic etiology given the background of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential atrial fibrillation or other rhythm disturbances that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring
This extended monitoring aims to guide secondary stroke prevention strategies in the context of the patient’s significant history of cerebral ischemia
